column7: The remaining half of #2424: a restore that crashed between installing its key files (TestWriteRestoredFileSet_CommitFailureCanStillLeavePartialInstall) could leave a complete-looking set with one file restored and the others old, which booted and failed at the first decrypt. writeRestoredFileSet now stages the restored hashes in the key-set manifest after preparing every file and before installing any, and commits after the last; boot classifies some files at the restored hashes and the rest not as an interrupted restore and refuses, naming both halves (no staging file exists to finish it from). Also TestWriteRestoredFileSet_RecordsTheRestoredSetInTheManifest and TestWriteRestoredFileSet_PrepareFailureStagesNothing (server/admin).
